{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df_loyal_completed[df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
qa_count = qa_orders.shape[0]

# Remove QA orders
df_loyal_completed_clean = df_loyal_completed[df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of completed LOYAL orders: {df_loyal_completed.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue 999999.99): {qa_count}")
print(f"Number of valid completed LOYAL orders after removing QA: {df_loyal_completed_clean.shape[0]}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
